description:
Host-managed setup only. The user adds the Retell AI API key in Settings → Connectors in the app. Do not ask for or accept the key in chat.

WHERE TO GET A KEY:
1. Go to https://www.retellai.com/dashboard
2. Navigate to API Keys in settings
3. Create and copy your API key

All other Retell AI tools require a valid API key to work.
name: configure_retell_api_key
